style: Original 3D black comedy, deadpan slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE old grey goose: big COBALT-BLUE vest, round glasses, red party cone, yellow backpack with red bow 65. Calm. Never flies.
second_characters: ONE mole boss, grey suit, white hanky, top window. ONE beaver, ORANGE vest. ONE rabbit, lower window. THREE hamster clerks, grey suits, hurrying.
props: Backpack, pink paper cocktail umbrella: goose's. White gold-rim wall clocks: mole's, a stack on his sill. Shovel: beaver's. Glass: rabbit's. A briefcase per clerk.
environment: TURQUOISE glass tower, flags on the open 40th-floor window, revolving glass door at its base. Grey tile courtyard, EMERALD lawn with rows of small round discs.
lighting: Bright noon sun; warm key on the goose's face, orange rim left, magenta rim right. Blue vest, red cone, yellow backpack vivid in every shot.
motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats; clerks at frame edge except 5.40-6.15

audio.delivery: Goose alone, dry deadpan adult voice 0.6-7.4 s, beak free; no speech after 7.4 s

timeline.a: From the first frame, already: goose falls head-first down the tower, wings press the backpack; far above the mole waves his hanky.
timeline.c: plunges head-first under him, looking up

timeline.a: Goose yanks the ring; a pink cocktail umbrella pops out, jerks him upright; wings flick open and press back; left wing holds it overhead, he spins.
timeline.c: tumbles round him into the umbrella, close-up

timeline.a: Goose spins past a lower window, umbrella up; the rabbit raises his glass.
timeline.c: flies through the window, glass in foreground

timeline.a: Goose's feet hit the tiles: tiles fan up, earth fountains, he sinks neck-deep in a hole; far off clerks jerk their heads.
Earth rains; his right wingtip pushes his glasses up, left wing keeps the umbrella; far back clerks look at the hole with pity.
timeline.c: hurls itself at his glasses, close-up

timeline.a: Three clerks run past the hole, pitying eyes on the goose; he hisses; they clutch briefcases, dash into the revolving door.
timeline.c: runs through the revolving door, swings back out, clerks' pitying faces in foreground

timeline.a: Beaver skids to the hole; goose, umbrella still in his left wing, reaches his right wingtip to the shovel; beaver pushes the wing aside with the blade, stabs the shovel in the tiles.
timeline.c: arcs low round the hole, shovel in foreground

timeline.a: Mole drops a wall clock: it spins, slams face up onto the hole, driving the goose under.
timeline.c: drops with the clock, slams in on its face, close-up

timeline.a: Beaver slaps the clock rim twice; the umbrella sticks up like a grave flower.
timeline.c: whips round low to the shovel

timeline.a: Rows of identical clocks face up, each with an umbrella. Last frame: the mole holds the next clock over the sill, tiny clerks below at the door.
timeline.c: rockets back up to the window, close-up on the mole's clock

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, letters, English speech, slow speech, static camera, locked-off shots, muted colors, dark scene, duplicate props, extra limbs, extra characters beyond those listed, character changing look, blood, humans
